name: That Time My School Was Invaded by Dimensional Snakes and Now I'm Bound to a Multiverse Protector!
source:
On a boring, sweltering Tuesday afternoon, the impossible happens. A massive, ink-black snake, as long as a riverbed, emerges from the scrubland beyond your high school. The police arrive and kill the beast, only to establish a horrifying reality: right where the first beast died, the ground tears open and three more identical, possibly larger, snakes burst forth simultaneously.

After a traumatic and bloody escape from the school campus, the world adapts. The Global Defense Coalition establishes an absolute "Containment Protocol," where humanity no longer tries to kill the invaders. Instead, specialized teams capture them in massive steel cages. For you and your fellow survivors—Kaito, Sho, Mika, and Yuta—the trauma lingers heavily. But the universe has strict rules, and actions have severe consequences. You are about to discover that surviving the initial massacre was only the beginning.

[From [url=https://hudarashi.itch.io/vn-dimensional-snakes]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个无聊闷热的周二下午，不可能的事情发生了。一条巨大的、墨黑色的蛇，如河床那么长，从你高中附近的灌木丛中出现。警察赶到并杀死了这只野兽，却发现了一个可怕的现实：就在第一只野兽死亡的地方，地面裂开，三条相似的、可能更大的蛇同时出现。

在经历了一次痛苦而血腥的校园逃亡之后，世界开始适应。全球防卫联盟建立了绝对的“遏制协议”，人类不再试图杀死入侵者。相反，专业团队将它们捕获在巨大的钢笼中。对于你和你的幸存者同伴——快斗、翔、美嘉和雄太来说——创伤依然挥之不去。但宇宙有严格的规则，行为会产生严重的后果。你将会发现，从最初的大屠杀中幸存下来只是一个开始。

[来自[url=https://hudarashi.itch.io/vn-dimensional-snakes]itch.io[/url]]
